statement: An employment contract is entered into in writing; it is also deemed entered into when the employee starts work that can, under the circumstances, be expected only for remuneration (Employment Contracts Act § 4(2)).
caveat: Missing written form does not void the contract (§ 4(4)), and the form requirement does not apply where the contract's duration does not exceed two weeks (§ 4(5)). The written document must state the working-conditions catalog of § 5(1), from the parties' identities to pay, working time, and leave.
